'''BFC Daugavpils''' is a [[Latvia]]n professional [[association football|football]] club that is based in [[Daugavpils]]. They play in the [[Latvian Higher League]]. The club plays its home matches at the Esplanādes stadions in [[Daugavpils]] with a capacity of around 700 people."}}
